personality: 6 Glass / Luxe structure with 7 Dark-First Utility arcade/neon accents
personality_one_liner: A mature, cinematic neon arcade experience driven by deep contrast, tactile solid surfaces, and glowing electric accents that demand one more round.

spacing.rule: Generous safe-area padding for immersion. Maintain tight grouping for HUD elements and spacious margins for primary actions. Use 16pt (lg) for screen edges.

do's: Simulate glass using RGBA variants of surfaceSecondary (e.g., rgba(20, 17, 32, 0.85)) combined with expo-linear-gradient since expo-blur is restricted.
Ensure a gradient-to-dark scrim is placed under text when floating over game board or hero image.
dont's: No blur/opacity on the actual gameplay tiles (they must remain sharp and tactile).
No blur on interactive booster buttons (they need solid contrast).

glass.ios: simulated via solid surfaceSecondary + expo-linear-gradient overlay
glass.android: simulated via solid surfaceSecondary + expo-linear-gradient overlay

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Instantly sell the premium game identity and funnel players into gameplay via a high-impact CTA.

states.error: Centered neon magenta text message with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Hero image (hero_background) fills screen under a top-to-bottom expo-linear-gradient scrim (transparent to surface). VaultPop title uses System font with letterSpacing: 4, size 3xl, and textShadow (brandPrimary glow). Massive 'Play' button sticky at thumb zone using solid brandPrimary.

screens.name: Mode Select
screens.purpose: Present the 3 game modes as premium, distinct experiences.
screens.layout: Vertical list of 3 massive cards (Classic, Daily Vault, Streak). Cards use surfaceSecondary with borderStrong outlines, subtle internal linear gradients matching their theme (Gold, Cyan, Emerald), and large touch targets.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.purpose: The core 8x8 puzzle board experience. Must be immersive, highly tactile, and distraction-free.
screens.layout: Top HUD: Cinematic stats (Score, Timer, Combo) in Cyan/Magenta. Center: 8x8 grid. Tiles are View components with borderStrong glow for selected states and RN Animated scale logic. Bottom: Vault meter (progress bar) and 3 tactile Booster buttons (Bonus Life, Chain Boost, Vault Burst) grouped like an arcade panel.

screens.name: Results
screens.purpose: Reward the player visually and encourage immediate replay.
screens.layout: Cinematic dark arcade summary. High contrast neon typography over a darkened grid_bg image. Score breakdown, Best Score indicator, and a sticky primary 'Play Again' button.

screens.name: Shop
screens.purpose: Present the in-game economy (Vault Coins, VaultPass, Boosters) with premium visual weighting.
screens.layout: Premium product cards using simulated glass panels. Visual hierarchy highlights the 'VaultPass' and 'Booster Forge' over simple text lists. 'Restore Purchases' as a subtle but accessible secondary link.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: User explicitly requested a deep black / navy / violet base (Theme: surface #08070D, surfaceSecondary #141120). This is a permitted exception to the standard 'No Navy' rule due to the explicit user prompt.
CRITICAL: System font ONLY. Use fontWeight (max 500) and letterSpacing to establish typographic hierarchy. E.g., Title: fontSize 24, fontWeight '500', letterSpacing 2.
CRITICAL: NO @expo/vector-icons allowed per constraints. All icons (chevrons, close buttons, stars) MUST be custom View-drawn glyphs or composed using stylized text elements.
CRITICAL: NO lottie, NO skia, NO reanimated. Use React Native's built-in Animated API for tile pops, button scales, and board interactions.
CRITICAL: Simulate glass using RGBA hexes matching surfaceSecondary with expo-linear-gradient overlays, as expo-blur is restricted.
Use expo-haptics extensively for the 'tap-to-clear' core mechanic, booster activations, and menu interactions to provide tactile feedback.
Tiles in the 8x8 grid must avoid text/letters entirely. Rely strictly on pure shapes, colors, and border highlights to differentiate objects.
